head: codex/5778-derived-terminal-finish
title: fix(csdlc): replace closeout churn with idempotent finish
body:
## Summary

- add one typed `csdlc-finish` command that merges only from exact green reviewed GitHub state
- derive terminal truth from live post-merge or approved no-PR GitHub state without a second tracked closeout PR
- serialize finish with canonical issue authority and retain only minimal rebuildable terminal cache evidence
- preserve exact-head decisive review state across later comment-only events
- retain legacy closeout only for bounded migration and repair

## Validation

- 168 focused C-SDLC v2 tests passed
- strict all-target clippy passed
- independent exact-head review passed with no remaining blockers
- live `closeout:no-pr-approved` repository label provisioned

Closes #5778
